title: xpute manifest
description: A program's manifest: the memory, fixed ranges, heap and stacks its guest asks for. A data spec, it is written into the guest and its host as any other is (xpute-gen data.rs), each table of u32s.

bytes.description: The guest's memory, whole before its first entry and never grown: the stack, the module's data, the fixed ranges and the heap.

fixed_bytes.description: The program's fixed ranges, past the module's data and before the heap, never freed.

min_heap_bytes.description: The heap the guest counts on, past the fixed ranges.

module_bytes.description: A module's stack, first in the memory.

thread_bytes.description: A native guest's thread's stack, outside the memory.
